_about: THE LIVE TRUST SET (S-5, WO-6). A source input, fixed into the production-channel artifact at build time.
It is EMPTY until C-3 (production release-signing key custody) is decided: before C-3 no live-mode release exists, and a
production-channel build trusts no key at all. After C-3 the Director issues a WO-6 revision recording the founder's public keys and
key ids, and the implementer's next candidate adds exactly those bytes here - nothing else, never a key the implementer holds.
Each entry: { "key_id": "ed25519:<sha256 of the 32-byte public key, hex>", "public_key": "<32-byte Ed25519 public key, base64url>" }.
